source: As we discussed earlier, I like your Christ well enough, but he isn't mine. Where I come from, we have hundreds of gods.
H-hundreds? You're... a h-heathen?
That's correct, yes. I am a heathen. I prefer my devas and asuras. Some wisdom here, a little trickery there... Gods with real personality.
Hmph. Well, I suppose we've little to say to one another, then. Let's speak no more ill of any gods, especially in a church.
Such a shame. I do so enjoy discussing this lily-faced, bearded, fatherly Lord of yours.
But as you wish, I'll leave you in peace.
...Listen, Rosie. Do you think... we've made a mistake in answering the King's letter?
Of course not. We're here to help Hamlet.
But if the King is hanging on every little detail we tell him...
...We do look like spies from the outside, don't we.
But if we love Hamlet, and want to see him flourish, then...
...We owe it to his parents to tell them about his state of mind.
My only concern...
...Is that Hamlet may not see it the same way.
And if he doesn't...
...It could mean our deaths.
Surely Hamlet wouldn't harm us, would he?
I cannot say what he'll do in his maddened grief. No one can.
What's clear is that we cannot trust this Ophelia girl.
She may have the best intentions, but her inquisitive nature is a threat to us.
Let's put our thoughts to action. We'll dog Hamlet's heels.
What was that sound?
The... outer gates...
B-Bernardo, who... who's comin' up the bridgeway?
Marcellus, I believe we have fallen into a trap.
Prince Fortinbras.
He's coming... I can see smoke from the town.
We have nothing prepared, thanks to the command to disarm. This is to be the end of us.
I guess Elsinore is really fallin', innit?
Yeh know, if yeh don' want to die here, Bernardo... yer a young man. You could get out. Get to the docks. Have a long, quiet life.
You ought to know me better than that.
...Marcellus, there's something I've never told you before.
I consider you to be one of the greatest, noblest, most kindhearted men it has ever been my pleasure to know.
Let us swear that whatever happens today, we shall someday raise our cups to one another in Heaven.
Don' say that yet! The day's not over! Tryin' to jinx us?
Who do you think, Marcellus?
Good thing we were prepared, eh?
Men! To Arms!
Good afternoon, gentlemen. We come with the utmost goodwill.
Goodwill? Do plumes of smoke signal goodwill in your land?
We have no tolerance for invaders.
Or liars, for that matter.
No one further need die today, so long as you submit to the will of my rule.
M'lord, we'd be awful sorry guards if we let yeh traipse on in and imprison our lord!
Denmark will never belong to the likes of you. Not if we can help it.
...So be it. The olive branch was refused.
Die, then.
Useless men that they are, they are no match for Our glorious might.
Onward, men. To the seat of power. Slay all who stand in our way.
The march towards the castle takes no prisoners.

source: At yer service, Captain.
Stand down, Fortinbras.
I am most impressed, Guard Captain, at your ability to rally in response to us.
But will it be sufficient? I think not.
Even if you take us all down, Elsinore will still stand with Denmark. Of that, I'm certain.
Let us find out, then. For me, with sorrow I embrace my fortune.
Why, it would seem you're outnumbered, my good man.
Now. Would you like to stand and fight, or turn tail and flee? We are honorable men, and will give you the option.
You have approximately ten seconds to make your choice.
After that, we'll gladly enjoy rending your armor plate from plate.
W-we will return! You cannot rebuke us forever!
Good. Bring every man who can hold a sword. We'll show you what Elsinore is really capable of.
We en't defended the sound for hundreds a' years without showing a few of yer kind who's in charge!
Run along home, and tell 'em Bernardo an' Marcellus sent you!
Ungh... retreat!
You are persistent, aren't you?
Look at you, burning away all the fates you earned. You've seen so many outcomes! So many possibilities!
And yet you've elected to choose none of them. Not only that, you've taken a match to them.
Your indecisiveness is, mmm, impressive.
Lord, what fools these mortals be!
Need I tell you to go away once more?
How rude. I come bearing a gift. Something to, ah, change up the game, so to speak.
You've already witnessed a small amount of the power the Book of Fates can bestow.
Wouldn't you like to... try something new?
To see things from my point of view?
I'll give you a little phrase you can say to harness the Book's power and alter the story.
What's the catch?
Oh! None at all, none at all.
Save that you'll know what using that power feels like.
And I think you'll find that once you've tried your hand at it... going back will be very, very difficult.
If you use it too much, some might even say it's impossible to return to the way things were!
But of course, you'll know when you've reached that point. We both will.
If the clock strikes midnight on Friday evening and you've used this power on everyone, we'll speak further.
You'll be a very different girl then, I suspect.
That was the last death.
All of them, gone.
What beautiful horrors you've wrought upon this world.
Do you feel thrilled now? Or frightened?
I feel...
I feel nothing.
They're just bodies. Just things. Just little dolls, or characters. They're not people, not really.
Yes. Yes!
Now you see. Now you understand. I did warn you you'd be a different woman when you came to this point.
And so you are.
Yes. There's simply nothing. No sadness. No pain.
As I thought. Come with me.
We've somewhere to go, you and I. Somewhere far away from Elsinore.
What can you mean? Somewhere else on earth?
No, Ophelia. Somewhere else entirely. A different world. A new place.
I must admit, I didn't realize how nice it would be to see someone else like me. Someone who understands.
The first time I used the Book's power to kill, I was so very frightened-- but that was so very long ago.
Once you learn to see them as tools, as pieces, there are so many more things you can do.
And there is yet time for all of them, now that peace has come to Elsinore.
I do so cherish this silence.
The ending!

source: Everyone, please, your swift attention is required. I'll be brief.
One of my men has located a... corpse.
I-it was in a rather horrifying state. Mangled beyond belief. Almost as if by a wild animal, but...
Without a wound.
Those of us who can are investigating further. Please stay alert. Remain in groups. Do not go anywhere alone.
Elsinore is locked down until further notice.
One of the guards has located a... corpse.
And Guard Captain Bernardo is... dead.
I've changed the world to create deaths in the past. Sometimes even deaths of people I loved.
But it wasn't like this. That was horrific.
Enjoying your new tool?
Not at all. This tool is cursed. Take it from me.
I thought this might happen. Indeed, I expected it! But you're mistaken.
You see, there is no such thing as a cursed tool, not really. A stone can be used to build a home or bludgeon a skull. The stone has no intention either way.
Regardless, this is wrong, what I'm doing.
Why am I listening to you anymore?
Why, indeed?
Au revoir for now!
Please, everyone, I know you have questions, but I have no answers at the moment.
At this time I'm ordering that all remaining citizens of Elsinore stay near the castle's center.
My men and I will patrol further.
Folks, I know yeh've got questions. My thanks for gatherin' here.
Those bodies you've heard about by now-- I saw one of the murders wiv' my own eyes.
Folks, I know yeh've got questions, but I ain                                                                                              ' got answers jus' yet.
Right now, we're mandatin' that all remaining citizens o' Elsinore stay near the castle's center.
The remainin' guards an' I will patrol further an' see what we can spot.
I called all of you here out of a desire to seek safety in numbers. Bernardo, Marcellus... both dead.
More mangled bodies have been uncovered.
We have yet to identify the cause. Everyone, group up. Watch your backs. Trust no one.
Remain close to the castle center.
Let us pray for a swift end to this nightmare.
(Why? Why can't I stop?)
(It's so easy to crush them all.)
I called all of you here because I didn't know what else to do. Bernardo, Marcellus, my uncle... all dead.
Remain in the Great Hall. No one is to leave.
I never thought life would come to this. My husband and son are both dead in the mere blink of an eye. And none of us know the cause.
There are bodies everywhere.
What little I know, I know this: We must trust one another if we are to survive. We must keep close.
Please don't stray too far. Please. For your own safety.
Please stay in this hall. Please. For your own safety.
L-ladies and gentlemen of the court, I... must inform you that there has been no end to the horror you've witnessed.
More bodies were discovered.
H-his majesty Claudius, Prince Hamlet, and Her Majesty Gertrude... all... have passed away.
You must all remain close. And calm. Please stay within sight of the Great Hall.
You must all remain close. And calm. Please stay within the Great Hall.
The wolf could be any one of us.
Everyone, remain close. All members of the Royal Family have perished.
A-and of my own family, only Ophelia and I remain.
At this point, I don't trust a single one of you save for my sister.
All of you remain within sight of the Great Hall, or I'll cut you down myself.
All of you remain within the Great Hall, or I'll cut you down myself.
Look. It's safer for all of us to gather here.
Someone is killing members of the court. All of us are in immediate danger.
If you value your life, don't leave sight of the Great Hall. The closer we are, the better a chance of survival we have.
If you value your life, don't leave the Great Hall. The closer we are, the better a chance of survival we have.
